title: TOLERANCE_WIRE
$comment: Producer csharp:Rasm.Fabrication/Spec/tolerance#OWNER_FOLD, the GdtFrameWire implementation of IToleranceEncoder. The crossing is FRAMED BINARY, not JSON: this schema defines the DECODED document each branch validates its own decode against, and the byte layout below is the contract the bytes hold. Encoding law - every count, collection length, option arity, and token byte-length is a u32 little-endian cell; every magnitude is an IEEE-754 binary64 little-endian cell; every digest is 16 big-endian bytes rendered :x32; every token is a u32 byte-length followed by that many UTF-8 bytes, and every admitted token is printable ASCII by its vocabulary's own key grammar. Field order IS the producer's member declaration order on FeatureControl, so a member the owner gains has one lawful wire seat. Byte order - magic GDTF, version, id, source.kind, source.digest, characteristic, scope, zoneKind, widthMm, the kind-discriminated zone tail, modifiers, datums, material, composite. The kind tail is the ONE conditional: unilateral and unequally-disposed carry offsetMm, projected carries heightMm, and bilateral, diameter, spherical, and profile carry nothing - the zone kind alone discriminates, so no arm tag rides beside it to contradict it. An Option frames as a count of 0 or 1 followed by that many elements, the same rule every collection follows.

version.description: Layout generation. A decoder refuses an unequal version rather than reading a shifted field, and a bump re-freezes the fixture.

id.description: CharacteristicId - the frame's own identity, the join key a consumer carries back to the specification.

source.description: ContentKey of the specification the frame controls. Consumers join on it and re-derive nothing.

widthMm.description: Tolerance zone width in millimetres, crossing as the exact magnitude. Decimal presentation is the consuming drawing standard's, never the producer's - a pre-rounded string collapses a sub-micron zone onto a drawn zero.

offsetMm.description: Unilateral or unequally-disposed zone offset in millimetres. Present exactly when zoneKind is unilateral or unequally-disposed.

heightMm.description: Projected zone height in millimetres. Present exactly when zoneKind is projected.

modifiers.description: Zone modifiers in ORDINAL-ASCENDING key order. Order is the wire's, not the producer's set iteration, so one frame encodes to one byte stream on every host.

datums.description: Datum references in PRECEDENCE order - position 1 is primary, 2 secondary, 3 tertiary. Position carries precedence whole, so no precedence token rides beside it.

material.description: Frame-level material condition. rfs is the ISO 1101 default and draws no symbol; the retired circled-S spelling is unreachable from this wire.

composite.description: The composite lower segment, an Option framed as a 0-or-1 count. Its datum labels are a subset of the upper datums.

allOf.$comment: The kind tail is total: each zone kind admits exactly the second dimension its payload carries, and no other.

digest.$comment: Seed-zero XxHash128 identity as 16 big-endian wire bytes, rendered at the lowercase :x32 spelling.

contentKey.$comment: Producer ContentKey whole - egress kind THEN digest, the order its own canonical form writes. Kind is identity-bearing: two egress families over equal bytes mint equal digests and different keys, so a consumer joining on the digest alone merges two artifacts.

egressKind.$comment: Producer egress family roster, in declaration order. A frame's source names the family that owns the bytes it controls.

characteristic.$comment: The ISO 1101 geometric characteristic roster, in the producer's declaration order. A peer maps each key onto its own ordinal-keyed owner through ONE ingest table; ordinals never cross, so a reordered roster re-maps nothing.

scope.$comment: The toleranced element the zone applies to. Scope decides how a leader terminates, so a consumer anchoring against it refuses a surface leader on a median-plane control.

zoneKind.$comment: The zone kind, carrying its prefix vocabulary and discriminating the byte tail. Keys cross, never the circled and prefixed symbols a consumer's own standard and font resolve.

materialCondition.$comment: ISO 2692 material condition. rfs is the default reading and the state that draws no compartment.

zoneModifier.$comment: ISO 1101 zone modifiers, in the producer's declaration order. Legality per characteristic and scope is the producer's admission, and a consumer decodes an admitted set rather than re-grading it.

datumLabel.$comment: One ISO 5459 reference letter, or a common datum as two letters joined by a hyphen. I, O, and Q stay out because each reads as a digit at drawing scale, and both ends compile this one class.

material.$comment: The datum's OWN material condition, independent of the frame's. Collapsing the two onto one column drops a datum modifier off the drawn frame.

compositeSegment.$comment: The lower segment of a composite frame - a second row inside the SAME box, so it crosses here rather than as a second frame. It carries no kind of its own: the upper segment's zone kind governs both rows.
